baseline.name: Build threshold graph and traverse per query
baseline.approach: Test all node pairs for edges, then run BFS/DFS for each reachability query.
baseline.time: O(n^2+q*(n+e)), for e edges and q queries

why: Sorted adjacent gaps completely determine connected components: every small-gap run has a connecting chain, and a large gap cannot be crossed by any permitted edge.
quantitative_comparison: The archive examines n-1 adjacent gaps and compares two labels per query. It avoids testing n(n-1)/2 possible edges and repeated traversals in the stated baseline. These work counts do not establish an elapsed-time multiplier.
tradeoffs: Requires sorted values and this specific difference-threshold graph. It is not a general replacement for graph traversal; shape/index checks and arithmetic bounds are trusted, and the source's cache guarantee is unmeasured.
evidence_basis: Static component invariant under the exact sorted-threshold problem assumptions; no benchmark.
